// REQ: LANG-2241 LANG-2242 LANG-2243 LANG-2244 /* Greeter class */ class Greeter { name = null constructor(n) { name = n } function greet(times) { local text = "Hello, " + name + "!\n" foreach (i, v in array(times)) print(text) return text.len() } } local g = Greeter("squirrel") if (g.greet(2) > 0 && true) print(@"raw \n text" + 0x1F)
